meta.hour_axis: L = hours since the official launch (FotV 2025-12-12 19:00 UTC, RoA 2026-05-29 20:00 UTC, FR 2026-09-04 20:00 UTC). GGG digest ids are unix hours; taken as the start of the hour covered (undocumented, +-1 h). L = app ls_price offset_h + 4 (FotV) or + 3 (RoA, FR).
meta.price_method: Per hour and item: volume-weighted price on each market against Exalted, Divine and Chaos, converted at that hour's Div:Ex and Chaos:Ex, combined weighted by Exalt value traded; then divided by that hour's Ex per Div. Day 3 and day 6-7 come from the app's ls_price (offset 72-95 and 144-167).
meta.coverage: 231 hourly digests fetched (L-1..L76 per league, 2.5 s apart), cached in scripts/cache. ls_price already held hours 0-167 as derived prices but no raw markets and nothing before the app's start_hour.
caveats: Single hours of thin items are noisy; peaks/bottoms use a 3-hour volume-weighted smoothing and ignore hours with <5% of the item's peak units.
Values of exactly 1.0 Ex in L3-10 are often 1:1 minimum trades, not real prices.
volume_traded units are undocumented; liquidity is a relative index (value traded per hour vs the L48-72 mean).
Exchange items only. No uniques or rares.

actions: Race the campaign. Pick up every currency item, essence, rune, uncut gem and omen; skip gear you will replace.
Do not spend Exalted, Chaos, Divine, Greater/Perfect orbs, essences or Annulments on your own items.
Pick a league-start build that does not need any trade to work.
keep: everything (the exchange is not open to you yet)
plan_72h.why: No trades at all before L2-3 in any launch. The exchange unlocks per league at Act 4 (0.3.0b, S44). Campaign mats are worth the most in the next 9 hours.

actions: At first exchange access (Act 4), sell the crash group at once, in small lots (the market is thin).
Swap every spare Exalted Orb for Divines right away. Never sell a Divine for Ex now.
Buy only what speeds up the campaign (MS boots, a weapon upgrade, a key levelling unique), paying in Ex.
sell: Lesser, normal, Greater and Perfect essences
Lesser Jeweller's Orb, Regal, Alchemy, Artificer's, Transmutation, Augmentation

the new league's own basic currency

Uncut Skill Gem level 1 and 20, Uncut Spirit gems level 14+
plan_72h.why: Crash-group medians are 1.4-3.1x their L12-24 Div price here, and 0.14-0.46x by day 6-7 (3/3). Ex per Div rises 40-61% per 6 h in L4-19. Ex loses 64-65% of its Div value by L60-72.

actions: Keep converting Ex to Div as it comes in (Div:Ex still +23-39% per 6 h in RoA/FR at L11-19).

Ancient liquid emotions if the league has them (peak L18-36)

actions: Sunday-Monday is the most liquid window of the first 3 days (L60-72 at 1.0-1.5x the L48-72 mean). Do your bulk selling and big buys here.
Read every hotfix. In past launches the first farm nerfs and drop-rate changes came on days 3-6 (0.4.0b L76, 0.5.0b Hotfix 13 L106, 0.5.1 L146, 0.5.5b L150). Sell a broken farm's output before then.
Start storing unique prices daily (no exchange data exists for uniques).
sell: Concentrated liquid emotions if they rose (mixed 2/3)
anything left from the crash group
keep: sink currency (Hinekora's, Architect's, Vaal infusers, Fracturing)

community_tips.tip: Rush the campaign/maps; the first hours of a fresh economy make the most currency per hour
community_tips.evidence: Campaign-drop groups sell for 1.4-3.1x their L12-24 price at L3-12 (essences, Greater orbs, Gnawed bones). But the exchange is thin: traded value is 1-7% of the L48-72 level before L12 and 25% only at L25-31. Endgame items first trade at L10-20, so only racers are in maps that early.

community_tips.tip: Don't use Exalted/Chaos/Divine during the campaign in a trade league
community_tips.evidence: Spending them on your own gear early wastes them: Div:Ex doubles L4 -> L18-24 (3/3), and Greater-tier orbs are worth 2-3x more at L3-12 than at L24+.

community_tips.tip: Buy your levelling uniques, resistances and MS boots with Exalts
community_tips.evidence: Paying in Ex is right: Ex loses 64-65% of its Div value L3-8 -> L60-72. But common levelling uniques are dearest on day 1-2: HC FR day 2 Wanderlust 0.20 Div vs 0.034 later, Tabula 4.9 vs 0.96 (outof.games, S22; HC, thin). Buy only what speeds you up.

community_tips.tip: Sell clean rare bases, uncut gems and bulk basic currency in hours 8-24
community_tips.evidence: Basic currency: L3-8 premium 3.2x (FotV) and 1.36x (RoA), none in FR. Uncut skill gems L16-19: 1.9-3.0x early, -63 to -75% by day 6-7 (confirmed). Uncut skill L20 and spirit gems L14+ rise instead (contradicted for them). Rare bases: no data.

community_tips.tip: An item sold on day 1 fetches about 3x its day-10 price
community_tips.evidence: True only for the crash group. Greater essences are at 0.23-0.34x of their L12-24 price by day 6-7, and at L3-12 they were 2.8-3.1x that price, so about 10x. The risers do the opposite: sink currency is 2.6-7x and top omens 1-3x by day 6-7.

community_tips.tip: Farm Exalted + Chaos first, convert to Divine later
community_tips.evidence: Converting LATER loses: Ex per Div rose 35 -> 98 (FotV), 25 -> 72 (RoA), 41 -> 114 (FR) from L3-8 to L60-72. Convert as you go.

community_tips.tip: Sell Exalted for Divines on a schedule / hold early Divines, spend Exalts
community_tips.evidence: Div:Ex never fell more than about 11% in any 6 h window in L4-72, and rose up to 61% in 6 h (FotV L8-14). Its fastest rise is L4-19 in all three launches.

community_tips.tip: Keep your liquidity in Chaos, not Exalts
community_tips.evidence: Chaos beat Ex in all three launches by day 6-7 (1 Chaos = 1.9 / 4.8 / 25 Ex, from 1.4 / 1.05 / 1.5 at L3-8). Against Div, Chaos lost 62-64% in 72 h in FotV and RoA and gained 51% in FR. By day 6-7 it gained in RoA and FR only.

community_tips.tip: Don't buy gear in the first 48 h / wait a few days, early prices are inflated
community_tips.evidence: On the exchange it holds for the crash group: Greater Jeweller's is -80% by L60-72 and -97% by day 6-7. It's wrong for risers, so buy those early: sink currency 2-3x by L60-72, Omen of Light +136 to +410% by day 6-7. Uniques: only HC snapshots, which show early premiums.

community_tips.tip: Don't buy Z until the weekend
community_tips.source: the player's example; no published PoE 2 source found
community_tips.evidence: All three launches started on a Friday, so the weekend is about L28-76, and liquidity is highest L60-72 (Monday daytime UTC). The crash group is far cheaper by then: Greater-tier orbs at 0.38-0.59x their L12-24 price. The risers are dearer, so for those, waiting costs you.

community_tips.tip: Prices are chaotic in the first 48 h; avoid panic-buying
community_tips.evidence: Within-hour Div:Ex high/low gap was 20-140% in L3-10 and first stayed under 15% at L18 (FotV) and L23 (RoA). Fewer than about 1,000 markets were active before L12.

community_tips.tip: Park wealth in omens (Light/Whittling); buy Hinekora's Lock early while cheap
community_tips.evidence: Omen of Light in Div, L12-24 -> day 6-7: +410% / +136% / +235%. Hinekora's Lock: +199% (RoA), +897% (FR), and 17 -> 60 Div in FotV from L24-36. Whittling is 2/3 only (RoA -18%).

community_tips.tip: Sell essences early
community_tips.source: common advice (Timesaver, Maxroll currency guide S23)
community_tips.evidence: Common, Greater and Perfect essences: best band L3-12 in 3/3, and 0.23-0.69x by day 6-7.

community_tips.tip: Don't stop to craft gear you'll replace within an hour / don't craft early
community_tips.evidence: Crafting inputs are dearest in L3-12 (Greater orbs 2-2.9x, Greater essences 2.8-3.1x), so using them early is costly. Crafting to sell (boots, amulets) can't be checked from exchange data.

community_tips.tip: Craft-and-sell movement-speed boots / belts / amulets on day 1
community_tips.source: IGGM 0.4 boots guide [seller] (S38); ConquestCapped [seller] (S39); SaVeQ and LilBotQ video titles (S40)
community_tips.evidence: No public data on rare-item sale prices. Seller claims: T1 MS boots 0.3-0.5 Div, good ones 6-10+ Div (0.4, Dec 22 2025).

community_tips.tip: Clear every campaign Ritual on night 1
community_tips.evidence: No drop data. 'Omens: other' sold for 2.6x their L12-24 price at L3-8 in FR, so early campaign omens are worth selling fast.

community_tips.tip: Save Tribute in campaign Ritual clusters for the boss unique shop (Mageblood chance)
community_tips.evidence: 0.5.5-specific; no data. Day-1 Mageblood/Headhunter video titles exist (Fubgun, Spicysushi).

community_tips.tip: Start with one mechanic and commit your first atlas points (Ritual / Expedition first)
community_tips.evidence: The exchange shows prices, not income per hour. Mechanic outputs differ: Expedition Logbook rose in RoA (0.21 -> 1.68 Div L24-36 -> day 6-7) but crashed in FR (2.28 -> 0.25).

community_tips.tip: Flip on the Currency Exchange early
community_tips.source: GGG forum thread (S43); Nex video title (S40); Maxroll flipping guide (S18)
community_tips.evidence: Wide early spreads (20-140% within an hour, L3-10) mean margins exist. But fills are slow in that window (1-7% of Sunday volume), and executable spreads can't be measured from public data.

community_tips.tip: Rush to Act 4 for the exchange / trade hideout
community_tips.evidence: The exchange unlocks per league at Act 4 (0.3.0b). The first trades appear 2-3 h after launch in all three launches, and the first hours carry the biggest premiums.

community_tips.tip: Common uniques are only expensive on day 1; then 'set in stone'
community_tips.evidence: HC FR day 2 vs later: Wanderlust 0.20 -> 0.034 Div, Goldrim 0.40 -> 0.088, Astramentis 4.0 -> 0.44 (S22). HC is thin, and no softcore day-1 data exists.

community_tips.tip: Hold Chaos for trading until you run T8+
community_tips.evidence: Same evidence as the Chaos tip above.

gear_notes.summary: Gear and uniques never go through the Currency Exchange, so there are no GGG curves. Everything here is from guide/tracker snapshots (see sources); treat as low-medium confidence.
levelling_uniques: Maxroll levelling list (0.5.4): Wanderlust, Bushwhack, Thrillsteel, Death Rush, Surefooted Sigil, Astramentis, Thief's Torment, Birthright Buckle, Greymake, Glowswarm, Midnight Braid, Goldrim, Tabula Rasa and others (S21).

Maxroll says cheap staples (Wanderlust, Glowswarm, Luminous Pace, Crown of the Victor, Revered Resin) are affordable any time, while Tabula Rasa, Thief's Torment and high-attribute Astramentis are expensive early and drop later (S21, fetched).

Day-2 HC Forbidden Rites (Sep 6 2026) vs SC FR about week 11: Wanderlust 0.20 -> 0.034 Div, Goldrim 0.40 -> 0.088, Thrillsteel 0.50 -> 0.16, Tabula Rasa 4.9 -> 0.96, Astramentis 4.0 -> 0.44, Ingenuity 0.097 -> 0.033 (outof.games, S22; HC is thinner and dearer than SC).
Inference: pay for levelling uniques in Exalts (Ex is the fastest-losing currency) and only for ones that shorten the campaign; Div-priced levelling uniques are cheaper from day 3-4.
early_rare_gear: Campaign targets: movement speed boots at levels 16/33/46 (15/20/25%), capped resistances and 25-30% MS boots for maps, +skill-level weapons for casters (Maxroll, S20).
Mid-patch prices (0.5.2, Jun 2026): ilvl 82 boots with 30% MS + a resistance about 1 Ex (Maxroll crafting guide, S24). Not a day-1 price.

0.4 day-10 seller claim (Dec 22 2025): T1 35% MS boots with weak other mods sell for 0.3-0.5 Div, good life/res/ES finishes 6-7 Div, top tier 10+ Div; 10 bases + omens cost about 1.5-3 Div (IGGM [seller], S38).
No dated day-1 prices were found for +level caster weapons, physical weapons or resistance jewellery.
chase_uniques_week1: Headhunter: 78 Div (HC FR day 2, Sep 6 2026) -> 11.2 Div (SC FR now); 60 Div SC RoA on Jul 24 2026; 0.2 about 40+ Div two weeks in (S22, S25).
Mageblood: 374 Div (HC FR day 2) -> 110 Div (SC FR now); 230 Div SC RoA Jul 24 2026 (S22).
Kalandra's Touch: 27 Div (HC FR day 2) -> 1.8 Div now (S22).
Day-1 Mageblood/Headhunter drops were possible in 0.5.5 from campaign Ritual unique shops (video titles by Fubgun and Spicysushi, S40).
Pattern (inference, low): chase uniques are dearest in week 1 in Div terms and fall as copies enter; buy build-defining uniques after day 4-5 unless they unlock a farm.
unique_price_behaviour: Seller guides: "prices are chaos in the first 48 hours", "most items normalise or drop in the second week" (S36, low).
No published PoE 2 source for "wait until the weekend"; the exchange data supports it only for the crash group.
one_point_zero: 1.0 launches Dec 11 2026 (PST). The hour is not announced; past launches were 11:00 PST (0.4) and 13:00 PDT (0.5, 0.5.5), i.e. 19:00-20:00 UTC (S45-S48).
New league "Conquerors of Wraeclast". Castle treasuries are the only source of new reforging materials (Crimson Iron, Infused Blood) (S46, S49).
Acts 5 and 6 are added, so the campaign is longer and map entry will likely come later than L10-20. Uniques now drop in the Acts (S46, S50).
1.0 is a new challenge league with a fresh economy (GGG FAQ wording, S47).

risks_week1.what: Hotfix 4 deleted every Cartographer's Chisel and Engineer's Orb on next login (they could drop by bug).
0.4.0b: more Tablet drops; gold vendor values fixed; Oisin's Oath added to the exchange.
0.4.0c: Temple rooms buffed, past-Temple benches take currency home; the temple boom that was nerfed on Jan 3 2026 (day ~22).
0.5.0b Hotfix 2: +10-15% Waystone quantity from map bosses on four atlas nodes.
Ritual reroll cost reduction capped at 90%.
0.5.0b Hotfix 13: major Temple nerf (a hidden mod made every pack rare).
0.5.1: Elite Abyss monsters lower damage, loot and XP; Kulemak atlas-point fix.
Runeforging un-fracture exploit closed; Hinekora's Lock remnant crafting disabled, then a guaranteed-Lock bug fixed.
Atzoatl Map Device disabled for about 3.5 h because of crashes.
Trial of Chaos ascendancy-point exploit and Ocean Expedition 3-site bug fixed.
0.5.5b: more Expedition, Temple and Delirium Tablet drops.
No rollbacks or bans for legal farming in any of the three windows. Big balance changes land on days 3-6; the 72 h window has mostly crash fixes.
